text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: That was a long, long time ago—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"‘I look forward to the day when you'll sing
for us again’... huh."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Compared to when I first debuted, the amount of fan letters I get has really gone down, but...)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (I still have people cheering for me too.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...The moon is so bright tonight.
It's even washing out some of the stars.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, as if I could ever reach it.
Even though I can't, still...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (...? Is that Senpai's voice?)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
I lost again...
*sniffle*... *sigh*... It's so frustrating...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win, and sing my song of gratitude...!
Today of all days, I wanted them to hear it...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text: And yet, why am I—!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I've never seen Senpai like that.
Senpai cries too...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(...Please. If there truly is a God...
Please let my senior's tears be rewarded.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(When that time comes, I'll celebrate with all my might.
I'll cheer until my throat goes hoarse.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Because I know Senpai's live performance
is going to be wonderful—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More and more people have come to know about the Grand Live lately.
This must be the fruit of our daily efforts.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Please lend us your support
for the Grand Live Reconstruction Plan!

text_block_list.name: Man in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do your best!
I'm rooting for you at the Grand Live!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Falco, there you are!
Is this that Grand Live thing?

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, let us help out too!
Actually, we went to see the concert the other day,
and it made us want to do it too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Really!? You should totally join in!
You're one of us now!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's our Falco!
Never missing a beat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as for the Umamusume participating—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...So those are the girls
talking about the Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could call out to her,
that Umamusume walked away...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sighing unconsciously basically happens when the sympathetic nervous system is dominant.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Why does that happen?
Because the blood vessels constrict to compensate
for the lack of oxygen in the bloodstream."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, why does that happen?!
Because of stress and worries
that tense your body and make your breathing shallow!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
What exactly does that mean, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I came to ask how you're feeling!
After all, you are a precious "possibility."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I really just don't understand you after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even that live concert issue...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—...?
Even though I'm feeling fine...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I wonder if something feels off with her leg.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Is this sense of incongruity a danger, or a possibility tied to a dream?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is both. Because your speed
is truly the closest thing
to the "unknown no one has ever reached."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If you try to reach the realm beyond that on your own, you might surpass your "limits."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I can tell. And I also know that crossing that line
would be a disadvantage to us both.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, as a fellow researcher, let me offer a proposal!
—The concept of a "Live."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Just as you told me to,
I participated in the Grand Live project."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you never know.
After all, a live show is "live", isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Concerts exist to express our gratitude
to the fans who support our racing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that's necessary when it comes to racing,
...but it has nothing to do with how I run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, there is. For you, at least.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! Why don't you try talking directly with your fans once in a while?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You might figure something out, you know?
Including what live performances mean to you."
